serviceFinding.whatWasThere: The page never mentions a certificate of service. It names service exactly once, inside a Stage 2 list of things to 'confirm ... with the clerk in the circuit of arrest' - which tells a self-represented filer that service is a local detail to ask about, not a requirement the record has already settled.
serviceFinding.whatTheRecordsActuallyHold: THREE records this family binds carry the requirement in identical words - 'Certificate of service at the court stage.' - at data/record-clearing/legal-design-intake/FL.memo.json tracks[fl-10yr-bridge].rules.service, data/record-clearing/legal-design-track-registry.json tracks[fl-10yr-bridge].rules.service, and data/record-clearing/legal-design-packet-set-manifests.json packetSets[fl-10yr-bridge-set].participantActionRequired[kind=serve_party].description, the last of which is requirement:'required'. The packet set declares four components and none of them is a certificate_of_service.
serviceFinding.whatTheRecordsDoNotHold: Any recipient and any method, for THIS track. Florida's OTHER tracks in the same memo do name recipients ('Certificate of service on three recipients at Stage 2'), and taking that number from a different track would have been fabrication. The repaired page states expressly that the records name neither and sends the participant to the clerk for that and only that.

repair.where: scripts/build-census-v1-fl-10yr-bridge-set.mjs. No delivered byte was hand-edited, and none could be.
what: serviceRequirement(): reads all three records at build time, asserts the sentence is stated identically by all three, asserts the serve_party action is still requirement:'required', asserts the sentence still names no recipient or method, and asserts the packet set still declares no certificate_of_service component. Any of those changing fails the build instead of printing a stale requirement.

A '## Certificate of service' section on participant-instructions.md quoting the record's sentence verbatim as a blockquote, then saying in plain language what a certificate of service is, that it is required here, that this packet contains none, that the records name no recipient or method, and that the absence of one from the packet does not mean none is owed.

The Stage 2 sentence no longer lists 'service' among the things merely to confirm with the clerk; it now directs the participant to prepare the certificate of service and confirm the genuinely local requirements.
repair.whyAssertedAndNotPinned: The receipt already binds all three of these records by whole-file SHA-256 and two of those three pins are stale at this base for reasons that have nothing to do with Florida. A whole-file pin cannot say whether THIS SENTENCE moved, which is the only thing the page depends on. This is the same conclusion FIX145 reached on ia-12347-set.
repair.nothingWasFabricated: The quoted sentence is the record's own, verbatim. No statute, form number, edition, deadline, recipient, service method, prosecutor act or judicial finding was authored by this lane.
